task: Evolve the existing responsive layout-depth authority into explainable Inheritance Intelligence with exact base-plus-viewport provenance, redundant-override drift diagnostics, deterministic bounded propagation plans and explicit application through existing responsive setters/resetters and Builder history, without restoring the legacy Desktop→Tablet→Mobile cascade.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Responsive layout mechanics are already PROVEN and the active Runtime deliberately uses base + exact viewport authority, while historical Desktop→Tablet→Mobile cascading is legacy-only. The Builder can inspect, set and reset viewport-local state, but it cannot yet explain the effective value's source, identify redundant/stale overrides, or safely propagate explicit responsive intent between selected viewports. Brabus Inheritance Intelligence must add those capabilities to the existing responsive layout-depth authority without changing Runtime semantics.
observableOutcomes: One canonical Inheritance Intelligence contract lives inside the existing storefront-responsive-layout-depth authority and reports base/exact-viewport provenance for visibility, grid placement, container flow and child order.
Diagnostics distinguish explicit viewport overrides from inherited/base/component/default values and identify redundant overrides that can be removed without changing effective rendering.
The active runtime continues to use base + exact viewport semantics; no Desktop→Tablet→Mobile implicit cascade is introduced.
A deterministic propagation planner accepts one source viewport, explicit target viewports and an allowlisted set of responsive dimensions and returns an immutable bounded plan.

Propagation copies the source viewport's direct intent: direct source overrides become explicit target overrides; absent source overrides reset the matching target dimension instead of inventing values.
Applying a propagation plan delegates only to existing set/reset responsive authorities and produces a normal Page Schema document that can be committed through existing Builder history/undo-redo.
No propagation operation touches unselected viewports or unrelated style/config keys.
The Builder responsive controls expose provenance/diagnostics and explicit target actions; there is no silent auto-propagation.
VX-INHERITANCE-INTELLIGENCE becomes PROVEN only after executable adversarial proof; Publish Readiness, Visual Diff Intelligence, Smart Intent and Smart Auto-Fix remain non-PROVEN.
unresolvedRisks: Accidentally using legacy cascade helpers would reintroduce breakpoint leakage already removed from the active Runtime.
Copying effective values instead of direct intent could freeze defaults into redundant overrides and create future drift.
A reset-style propagation could erase unrelated viewport style properties such as backgroundColor.
Child-order propagation could accept stale or foreign node IDs and silently reorder the wrong tree.
A propagation plan could be replayed after the document changed and overwrite newer responsive intent unless source/target fingerprints are validated.
Diagnostics could treat legitimate responsive differences as drift and later mislead Publish Readiness or Auto-Fix.
Direct helper application outside Builder history could make propagation non-undoable in the UI.

in: Explainable source/provenance inspection for responsive visibility, grid placement, container layout and child order.
Redundant override diagnostics based on effective-state equivalence after dimension-local reset.
Deterministic immutable propagation-plan contract with source and target fingerprints.
Explicit bounded propagation across selected viewports only.
Application through existing responsive layout/fidelity setters and resetters.
Responsive Builder controls for diagnostics and explicit propagation actions.
Undo/redo integration through existing onApply → commitDocument → Builder history path.
Maturity promotion with adversarial executable proof.
out: Automatic cross-viewport propagation without explicit target selection.
New Page Schema, renderer, persistence, publish endpoint, database mutation or Control Plane gate.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Responsive propagation can silently damage all three canonical viewports and later feed Smart Intent/Auto-Fix, so the highest practical assurance is deterministic provenance, stale-plan rejection, dimension-local operations, exact target scoping, regression proof against legacy cascade semantics and normal Builder history integration.

acceptanceCriteria: Inheritance inspection reports, for every canonical viewport, whether each supported dimension is direct or fallback-derived and exposes the effective state without consulting legacy cascade helpers.
Redundant override diagnostics are emitted only when resetting that same dimension on that same viewport preserves its effective state.
Propagation plans are deterministic, immutable and bind page identity, node identity, source viewport, explicit target viewports, selected dimensions and source-state fingerprint.
Plans with duplicate/invalid/source-equal targets, missing nodes or unsupported dimensions fail closed.
Applying a stale plan after the source node's responsive state changes fails closed rather than replaying old intent.
Direct source overrides are copied to targets; absent source overrides cause dimension-local target reset, preserving unrelated style/config keys.
No plan mutates a viewport outside its explicit target set.
Child-order propagation uses only known children and existing fidelity order authority.
Builder UI shows provenance/diagnostic state and explicit propagation controls; applying through onApply remains undoable/redoable.
Runtime exact-viewport behavior and legacy-cascade isolation tests remain unchanged.
VX-INHERITANCE-INTELLIGENCE becomes PROVEN while VX-VISUAL-DIFF-INTELLIGENCE, VX-PUBLISH-READINESS, VX-SMART-INTENT and VX-SMART-AUTOFIX remain non-PROVEN.
invariants: Active responsive override authority is exact viewport; base style may feed every viewport, but sibling viewport overrides never implicitly inherit.
LegacyCascade functions remain migration-only and are never imported by Inheritance Intelligence.
Page Schema and existing fidelity/responsive setters remain mutation authorities.
Propagation is opt-in, bounded to explicit targets and produces no persistence or publish side effects.
Resetting one responsive dimension cannot erase unrelated viewport styles or config.
Diagnostics are explanatory evidence, not automatic mutation authority.
Every applied document remains a normal Builder history entry.

failureModes: Tablet override is mistaken for Mobile inheritance and silently copied.
Source has no direct override but planner serializes its current effective default as a new direct target override.
Redundant-override detector removes a value whose fallback differs after reset.
Propagation resets container layout and accidentally removes unrelated background/style properties.
Source state changes after planning but the stale plan still applies.
Target list contains source viewport or duplicates and application order becomes ambiguous.
Child order contains stale node ids and propagation corrupts order metadata.
UI applies propagation outside Builder history and undo cannot restore the prior document.
edgeCases: Source viewport has no overrides in any selected dimension.
Source has only visibility override while target has container and grid overrides.
Base visual style equals a viewport direct style exactly, making the direct override redundant.
Grid node and stack node require different container-operation shapes.
Leaf node has no child-order dimension.
All two non-source viewports are selected together.
A target already exactly matches source direct intent.
Same plan is evaluated twice against unchanged document and must produce identical output.
Plan is applied after an unrelated style property changes and should remain valid if its bound responsive source fingerprint is unchanged.

alternatives.summary: Evolve current responsive layout-depth authority with explainable base/exact-viewport provenance and explicit bounded propagation.
alternatives.reason: Matches the active Runtime contract and preserves breakpoint isolation while providing the intelligence needed by later Publish Readiness, Smart Intent and Auto-Fix.
The repository explicitly isolates that behavior as legacy migration semantics because it causes sibling-breakpoint leakage.

alternatives.summary: Create a separate responsive intelligence engine with its own mutation model.
alternatives.reason: Would duplicate Page Schema/Fidelity authorities and violate the no-parallel-system requirement.

specialistReviews.finding: Runtime and Visual Style already define exact-viewport plus base semantics, and responsive layout-depth centralizes the supported Builder controls.
specialistReviews.resolution: Extend storefront-responsive-layout-depth.ts rather than creating a second inheritance authority.

specialistReviews.finding: The repository still contains LegacyCascade helpers, so careless reuse could silently restore the old behavior.
specialistReviews.resolution: Inheritance Intelligence must not import LegacyCascade functions and gets explicit regression tests proving sibling viewport isolation.

specialistReviews.finding: A propagation plan can become stale between preview and application.
specialistReviews.resolution: Bind plans to deterministic source-state fingerprints and fail closed when the bound node responsive state no longer matches.

specialistReviews.finding: Automatic propagation would be surprising and could erase deliberate breakpoint differences.
specialistReviews.resolution: Expose source explanation, warnings and explicit target buttons only; no silent propagation.

challenge.scenario: Desktop has gridSpan=8; Tablet has none; Mobile has gridSpan=12.
challenge.finding: Legacy mental model may incorrectly claim Tablet inherits Desktop.
challenge.resolution: Inspection reports Tablet runtime/default source and never reads Desktop override.

challenge.scenario: Desktop source has no direct container override; Tablet has a custom container override.
challenge.finding: Copying effective Desktop values would freeze defaults rather than source intent.
challenge.resolution: Propagation resets Tablet container dimension to fallback when source has no direct override.

challenge.scenario: Tablet gap override equals base/config effective gap.
challenge.finding: Override adds drift risk without changing rendering.
challenge.resolution: Dimension-local reset equivalence emits REDUNDANT_OVERRIDE diagnostic.

challenge.scenario: Target mobile also has backgroundColor in its viewport style.
challenge.finding: Container propagation could erase unrelated style.
challenge.resolution: Existing allowlisted patch/reset functions touch only container keys; test preserves backgroundColor.

challenge.scenario: User previews a propagation plan then edits source responsive state before applying.
challenge.finding: Old plan would no longer represent user intent.
challenge.resolution: Plan binds deterministic source-state fingerprint; application rejects stale fingerprint.

challenge.scenario: Source and target are the same viewport or target list duplicates a viewport.
challenge.resolution: Planner fails closed on source-as-target and canonicalizes/rejects duplicate targets.
Plan derives order through existing resolver and validates exact known-child set before application.

challenge.scenario: Propagation is applied from Builder UI.
challenge.finding: Direct document replacement could bypass undo/redo.
challenge.resolution: Controls call onApply and existing applyFidelity→commitDocument→pushStorefrontBuilderHistory path; UI proof locks this.

proofPlan: Exact viewport provenance proof demonstrates Desktop override never becomes Tablet/Mobile source.
Redundant override proof compares effective state before/after dimension-local reset and avoids false positives.
Determinism proof creates identical propagation plan/fingerprint/output twice from identical input.
Target-isolation proof shows only explicit target viewports change.
Stale-plan adversarial proof mutates source responsive intent after planning and requires application to reject.
Unrelated-style preservation proof keeps non-layout viewport style keys unchanged through set/reset propagation.
Grid, stack, visibility, placement and child-order propagation/reset combination proof.
Builder UI source/diagnostic/explicit propagation proof plus existing history path assertion.
Legacy cascade exclusion proof ensures intelligence source contains no LegacyCascade imports/calls.
Maturity proof promotes only VX-INHERITANCE-INTELLIGENCE; the other four VX blockers stay non-PROVEN.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Existing responsive authority provides exact base/viewport provenance and drift diagnostics without restoring legacy cross-viewport cascade.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Active Inheritance Intelligence cannot use legacy Desktop→Tablet→Mobile cascade semantics.

requirements.requirement: Responsive intent propagation is deterministic, stale-safe, dimension-local, explicit-target-only and applies through existing setters/resetters and Builder history.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Propagation cannot silently mutate unselected viewports, unrelated style keys, persistence or publish state.

requirements.requirement: Inheritance Intelligence completion does not promote Visual Diff Intelligence, Publish Readiness, Smart Intent or Smart Auto-Fix.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Inheritance completion cannot imply the remaining VX intelligence capabilities are proven.

notes: Eighth Brabus hardening wave. Factory Genome, Type System, Constraint Planner, Media Planner, deterministic lineage, anti-clone and Dynamic Production Compiler are PROVEN and lifecycle-closed. Dependency order for remaining VX blockers: Inheritance Intelligence → Visual Diff Intelligence → Publish Readiness → Smart Intent → Smart Auto-Fix. This wave handles only Inheritance Intelligence. Template #3 remains forbidden.
